thesis: Neuland Laboratories is the best-run company in the promise-tracking universe (credibility 9.6/10 — management says what it will do and does it) and a genuine CRAMS compounder (ROCE 21-27%, 17% 5yr sales CAGR, Mukul Agrawal's largest holding at Rs 496cr). The $30M peptide module (operational Sep-2026) is a real GLP-1/CDMO option. But Rs 21,055 (54x TTM earnings, 14.5x book, 45x EV/EBITDA) prices a flawless GLP-1 transformation, not the business as it stands. Fundamental fair value is ~Rs 4,300; the market implies FY31 revenue of ~Rs 17,800cr (54% CAGR). Wonderful company, uninvestable price.

valuation_detail: Base DCF Rs 4,300 (w=12.9%). Bull case (25% revenue CAGR on peptide success): ~Rs 9,900 — still less than half the current price. The Rs 21,055 price needs either 35%+ sustained growth for a decade or a discount rate the risk doesn't support. P/BV 14.5x vs 3x fair = the multiple is doing all the work.

verdict.judgment: No upgrade. This is the rare case where the business is genuinely excellent (C5=9.6, ROCE 21%, Mukul's largest holding) but the price has completely detached from fundamentals. PASS is not a comment on the company — it is a comment on Rs 21,055.
